main.description: A flair definition — a badge any account (person, org, agent) may issue. Lives in the ISSUER's repo; the record key is a lowercase slug matching [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63} chosen at creation and referenced by grants and badges. The issuer's account is the counterpart of every wear: policy 'open' is a standing consent (anyone may wear it), policy 'granted' requires a matching at.tessera.flair.grant per wearer.

policy.description: open = this definition itself authorizes anyone to wear the flair; granted = only wearers with a matching at.tessera.flair.grant in this repo. Consumers MUST fail closed on any other value.

criteria.description: Human-readable rules for earning this flair. Enforced by the issuer (who writes the grants), never by the protocol — the grant is the proof the rules were met.
